desc: A fox spirit in a pale lavender hooded cape, big pointed ears, a large fluffy tail with a gold star tip, small gold bell. Cute but cool game pet creature, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body. True 16-bit pixel art, uniform 1px dark navy outline, 2-3 flat shade colors, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no noise. Small crisp dark eyes with 1px white highlight, friendly not scary. Lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold palette. No halo, no sparkles, no shadow.
